faq.title: Billing questions
faq.subtitle: Anything else? Our team answers within a working day.

q1.a: Anyone who can create or change dashboards. Viewers are always free and unlimited.

q2.a: Yes. Upgrades apply immediately and are prorated; downgrades apply at the next renewal.

q3.a: 50% off for nonprofits and education, and startup credits for companies under two years old.

q4.q: What payment methods do you accept?
q4.a: Cards on all plans, plus invoices and bank transfer on yearly Growth and Scale.

q5.q: What happens to my data if I cancel?
q5.a: You keep read-only access for 30 days and can export everything. After that it is deleted.

start.title: Getting started
start.body: Set up your workspace and team.

q1.a: Open Settings → Members and invite by email. Viewers are free on every plan.

q2.q: Why does a number differ between dashboards?
q2.a: Usually two different metric versions or filters. Open the number to see its definition and version.

q3.q: Can I connect a database behind a firewall?
q3.a: Yes, through an SSH tunnel or by allow-listing our static IP addresses.

q4.a: Settings → Billing → Cancel plan. You keep read-only access for 30 days.
